title: Package shows with T-Bone Walker and Joe Turner
summary: The band backed Slim, T-Bone Walker and Joe Turner in Texas, which he thinks was an early package show.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, it's also probably cheaper in that you had one band and three artists in those days. You always, which...
That's what happened. So that's what happened. We played for T-Bone Walker, played for Joe Turner, and also played for Slim, all on the same stage.
Was that a lot of pressure, to have to learn three new material?
Yeah, blues, blues, man. That's all to it. You know, the formation for the blues, that's all. How you gonna end it, how you gonna start it, that's all.
No, there's nothing hard about that. I just wanted somebody to be under pressure. Of course, if you're playing a long two or three weeks with somebody, you're gonna get better.
